title: 深夜的暖心鼓勵
content: 小婷深夜手癢想去抽菸，她記起媽媽曾說：『你就是最厲害的自己。』她放下菸盒，打開窗戶，讓月光進來，3 分鐘後心裡的那個聲音漸漸平靜下來。

title: 和朋友一起約定
content: 阿傑和好友約定今天不抽菸，兩人一起送外送，聊天分散了癮頭。當晚他回家時發現，沒有菸的夜晚居然也能這麼安穩。

title: 放下菸盒的第一步
content: 小林第一次把菸盒放進抽屜，寫下：『明天再試一次，為自己加油。』這個簡單的儀式，成了他每天重啟決心的開始。

title: Late-night encouragement
content: Anna almost reached for a cigarette at midnight, then remembered her own promise. She opened the window, breathed slowly, and the urge faded within minutes.

title: A promise with friends
content: Jake and his friends agreed to avoid cigarettes today. They spent the afternoon talking and laughing, and discovered a smoke-free night can feel surprisingly peaceful.

title: The first step
content: Lina put her cigarette pack away and wrote: 'Try again tomorrow, keep going.' That small act became her daily reset and a real source of strength.
